fee_notes: The initial franchise fee is negotiated based on factors including population, demographics, competition, existing advertising/sales, and average household income. During 2025, the range charged was $10,000 to $127,267. As a general rule, the fee is approximately $20,000 per 100,000 in population in the Franchised Area; typically the range is $20,000 to $100,000. The fee can be paid in a lump sum or financed under Option A (deferred portion over 6 months to 5 years at prime rate + up to 5% per annum) or Option B (deferred portion paid via an additional 3% monthly royalty on gross sales until paid in full). The fee is non-refundable, except that under Option B, unpaid deferred amounts are forgiven upon early termination. An option fee of up to 10% of the estimated initial franchise fee may be paid to reserve an area for up to 6 months and is applied toward the initial franchise fee if a franchise is purchased.
raw_excerpt: During 2025, the range of initial fees charged to franchisees was $10,000 to $127,267. As a general rule, the initial franchise fee is approximately $20,000 for each 100,000 in population or fraction of 100,000 in population in your Franchised Area. Typically, the range of initial franchise fees charged to franchisees is $20,000 to $100,000.
